<p class="bms-glossary-term-name">Blunder</p>
<p class="bms-glossary-definition">Players use Blunder to describe a large checker-play or cube error, often defined by analysis software as losing at least 0.080 equity. The term gives players a shared way to talk about this part of the game.</p>
